# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

import json
import math
import sys
import time
import cmath

# --- Linear Algebra Helper ---
class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, rows, cols, data=None):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cols = cols
        if data:
            self.data = data
        else:
            self.data = [[0.0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.data[idx]

    def __str__(self):
        return '\n'.join([' '.join([f"{x:.4f}" for x in row]) for row in self.data])

    @staticmethod
    def identity(n):
        res = Matrix(n, n)
        for i in range(n):
            res.data[i][i] = 1.0
        return res

    @staticmethod
    def zeros(rows, cols):
        return Matrix(rows, cols)
    
    def multiply_vec(self, vec):
        if self.cols != len(vec):
            raise ValueError("Dimension mismatch")
        res = [0.0] * self.rows
        for i in range(self.rows):
            s = 0.0
            row = self.data[i]
            for j in range(self.cols):
                s += row[j] * vec[j]
            res[i] = s
        return res

def mat_mul(A, B):
    if A.cols != B.rows:
        raise ValueError(f"Dimension mismatch: {A.cols} != {B.rows}")
    C = Matrix(A.rows, B.cols)
    for i in range(A.rows):
        for k in range(A.cols):
            val_a = A.data[i][k]
            if val_a == 0: continue
            row_b = B.data[k]
            row_c = C.data[i]
            for j in range(B.cols):
                row_c[j] += val_a * row_b[j]
    return C

def solve_linear(A, b):
    # Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting
    # A is Matrix, b is list
    n = A.rows
    if n != A.cols: raise ValueError("Not square")
    
    # Copy A and b to avoid modifying originals
    M = [row[:] for row in A.data]
    x = b[:] # Copy b
    
    # Indices for pivoting
    p = list(range(n))
    
    for i in range(n):
        # Pivot
        max_val = abs(M[p[i]][i])
        max_idx = i
        for k in range(i+1, n):
            if abs(M[p[k]][i]) > max_val:
                max_val = abs(M[p[k]][i])
                max_idx = k
        
        if max_val < 1e-12:
            raise ValueError(f"Singular matrix at index {i}")
            
        p[i], p[max_idx] = p[max_idx], p[i]
        
        pivot = M[p[i]][i]
        
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            factor = M[p[j]][i] / pivot
            M[p[j]][i] = factor # Store multiplier
            for k in range(i+1, n):
                M[p[j]][k] -= factor * M[p[i]][k]
            x[p[j]] -= factor * x[p[i]]

    # Back substitution
    res = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        s = sum(M[p[i]][j] * res[j] for j in range(i+1, n))
        res[i] = (x[p[i]] - s) / M[p[i]][i]
        
    return res

# --- Data Loading ---
def load_network(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data

# --- Ybus Construction ---
def make_ybus(bus, branch):
    nb = len(bus)
    # Map bus ID to index 0..nb-1
    bus_id_map = {b[0]: i for i, b in enumerate(bus)}
    
    Y = [[0j] * nb for _ in range(nb)]
    
    # Shunt admittances
    for i in range(nb):
        Gs = bus[i][4]
        Bs = bus[i][5]
        Y[i][i] += complex(Gs, Bs) / bus[0][2] # Assuming baseMVA is in data or 100? Data has baseMVA field
        # Wait, network.json has baseMVA at root.
        # Bus columns: 4 is Gs, 5 is Bs. usually in MW/MVAr at 1 pu voltage? 
        # Matpower format: Gs, Bs are in MW/MVAr demand at V=1.0. So divide by baseMVA to get pu.
    
    # Branches
    for br in branch:
        f = bus_id_map[br[0]]
        t = bus_id_map[br[1]]
        r = br[2]
        x = br[3]
        b = br[4]
        tap = br[8]
        shift = br[9]
        status = br[10]
        
        if status == 0: continue
        
        z = complex(r, x)
        y = 1.0 / z
        bc = complex(0, b)
        
        if tap == 0: tap = 1.0
        shift_rad = math.radians(shift)
        tr = tap * cmath.exp(1j * shift_rad)
        
        Yff = (y + bc/2) / (abs(tr)**2)
        Yft = -y / complex(tr.conjugate())
        Ytf = -y / tr
        Ytt = y + bc/2
        
        Y[f][f] += Yff
        Y[f][t] += Yft
        Y[t][f] += Ytf
        Y[t][t] += Ytt
        
    return Y, bus_id_map

# --- Power Flow ---
def make_mismatch(V, Sbus, Y):
    # S = V * conj(Y * V)
    # Mismatch = Sbus - S
    nb = len(V)
    I = [0j] * nb
    for i in range(nb):
        for j in range(nb):
            if Y[i][j] != 0:
                I[i] += Y[i][j] * V[j]
    
    mis = []
    for i in range(nb):
        S_calc = V[i] * I[i].conjugate()
        mis.append(Sbus[i] - S_calc)
    return mis

def newton_pf(Y, bus, gen, bus_id_map, baseMVA, verbose=False):
    nb = len(bus)
    
    # Initial V
    V = []
    Va = []
    Vm = []
    for i in range(nb):
        Vm.append(bus[i][7])
        Va.append(math.radians(bus[i][8]))
        V.append(cmath.rect(Vm[i], Va[i]))
        
    # Build Sbus (Load - Gen)
    # Pd, Qd in bus
    Pd = [bus[i][2] / baseMVA for i in range(nb)]
    Qd = [bus[i][3] / baseMVA for i in range(nb)]
    
    Pg = [0.0] * nb
    Qg = [0.0] * nb
    
    pv_buses = []
    pq_buses = []
    ref_buses = []
    
    for i in range(nb):
        btype = bus[i][1]
        if btype == 3: ref_buses.append(i)
        elif btype == 2: pv_buses.append(i)
        else: pq_buses.append(i)

    # Add generation to Pg, Qg
    for g in gen:
        if g[7] > 0: # status
            idx = bus_id_map[g[0]]
            Pg[idx] += g[1] / baseMVA
            Qg[idx] += g[2] / baseMVA
            # Enforce V setpoint for PV/Ref
            if bus[idx][1] in [2, 3]:
                Vm[idx] = g[5]
    
    # Update V complex
    for i in range(nb):
        V[i] = cmath.rect(Vm[i], Va[i])

    Sbus = [complex(Pg[i] - Pd[i], Qg[i] - Qd[i]) for i in range(nb)]
    
    # Newton loop
    max_it = 10
    tol = 1e-8
    
    for it in range(max_it):
        mis = make_mismatch(V, Sbus, Y)
        
        # Check convergence
        p_mis = [x.real for x in mis]
        q_mis = [x.imag for x in mis]
        
        norm = max(max(abs(x) for x in p_mis), max(abs(x) for x in q_mis))
        if verbose: print(f"Iteration {it}, Norm: {norm:.6e}")
        if norm < tol:
            return V, True
            
        # Build Jacobian
        # Size: (nP + nQ) x (nTh + nV)
        # Unknowns: Theta at PV+PQ, Vm at PQ
        # Equations: P at PV+PQ, Q at PQ
        
        non_ref = pv_buses + pq_buses
        pq = pq_buses
        
        n_non_ref = len(non_ref)
        n_pq = len(pq)
        dim = n_non_ref + n_pq
        
        J = Matrix(dim, dim)
        
        # Precompute I
        I = [0j] * nb
        for i in range(nb):
            for j in range(nb):
                if Y[i][j] != 0:
                    I[i] += Y[i][j] * V[j]
        
        # Derivatives
        # dS_i / dTh_j 
        # dS_i / dVm_j
        
        # Diagonal elements
        for i_idx, i in enumerate(non_ref):
            # dP/dTh_i, dQ/dTh_i
            # S = V * conj(Y V)
            # diag terms involve all neighbors
            
            # Simplified Logic:
            # dSi/dThi = j * Vi * conj(Ii) - Vi * conj(Yii * Vi) + ... complex
            # Actually easier: S = Vi * conj(sum Yij Vj)
            # dSi/dVi = conj(Ii) + Vi * conj(Yii)
            
            val = 1j * V[i] * I[i].conjugate()
            # BUT Y_ii contribution subtracts?
            # Standard formulas:
            # dP/dTh = -Q - V^2 B
            # dQ/dTh = P - V^2 G
            # dP/dV = P/V + V G
            # dQ/dV = Q/V - V B
            
            # Let's use numeric or exact. Exact is better.
            # dSi/dTh_i = d(Vi * conj(Ii))/dTh_i
            # Vi = Vm e^jTh
            # dVi/dTh = j Vi
            # dSi/dTh = j Vi * conj(Ii) + Vi * conj(dIi/dTh)
            # dIi/dTh = sum Yij dVj/dTh. Only j=i term: Yii * j Vi
            # So dSi/dTh_i = j Vi conj(Ii) + Vi * conj(Yii * j Vi)
            #               = j Vi conj(Ii) - j Vi conj(Yii) conj(Vi)
            #               = j S_calc_i - j |Vi|^2 conj(Yii)
            
            S_calc = V[i] * I[i].conjugate()
            diag_dTh = 1j * S_calc - 1j * (abs(V[i])**2) * Y[i][i].conjugate()
            
            J.data[i_idx][i_idx] = diag_dTh.real # dP/dTh
            if i in pq_buses:
                row_q = n_non_ref + pq_buses.index(i)
                J.data[row_q][i_idx] = diag_dTh.imag # dQ/dTh
                
            # dSi/dVm_i
            # Vi = Vm e^jTh
            # dVi/dVm = Vi / Vm
            # dSi/dVm = (Vi/Vm) conj(Ii) + Vi conj(Yii * Vi/Vm)
            #         = (1/Vm) (S_calc + |Vi|^2 conj(Yii))
            
            diag_dVm = (1.0/Vm[i]) * (S_calc + (abs(V[i])**2) * Y[i][i].conjugate())
            
            if i in pq_buses:
                col_v = n_non_ref + pq_buses.index(i)
                J.data[i_idx][col_v] = diag_dVm.real # dP/dVm
                row_q = n_non_ref + pq_buses.index(i)
                J.data[row_q][col_v] = diag_dVm.imag # dQ/dVm
                
            # Off-diagonal
            # dSi/dTh_j = Vi * conj(Yij * j Vj) = -j Vi conj(Yij) conj(Vj)
            # dSi/dVm_j = Vi * conj(Yij * Vj/Vm_j) = Vi conj(Yij) conj(Vj) / Vm_j
            
            for j_idx, j in enumerate(non_ref):
                if i == j: continue
                if Y[i][j] == 0: continue
                
                term = V[i] * Y[i][j].conjugate() * V[j].conjugate()
                off_dTh = -1j * term
                
                J.data[i_idx][j_idx] = off_dTh.real
                if i in pq_buses:
                    row_q = n_non_ref + pq_buses.index(i)
                    J.data[row_q][j_idx] = off_dTh.imag
                    
            for j_idx, j in enumerate(pq_buses):
                if i == j: continue
                if Y[i][j] == 0: continue
                
                term = V[i] * Y[i][j].conjugate() * V[j].conjugate()
                off_dVm = term / Vm[j]
                
                J.data[i_idx][n_non_ref + j_idx] = off_dVm.real
                if i in pq_buses:
                    row_q = n_non_ref + pq_buses.index(i)
                    J.data[row_q][n_non_ref + j_idx] = off_dVm.imag

        # Solve
        # Vector b
        b = []
        for i in non_ref:
            b.append(p_mis[i])
        for i in pq:
            b.append(q_mis[i])
            
        dx = solve_linear(J, b)

        c1 = c[5] if n >= 3 else (c[4] if n>=2 else 0)

        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": [],
        "feasibility_check": {}
    }

    total_gen_P = 0

    total_load_Q_val = sum(Qd)

        "total_load_MW": round(total_load_P_val, 2),

        t = bus_id_map[br[1]]

        x = br[3]
        b = br[4]
        tap = br[8] if br[8] else 1.0

        # Yseries = 1/z

        # Admittance matrix elements used above:

        # Yft = -y / conj(a)
        
        # S_ft = V_f * conj(I_ft) = V_f * conj(Yff V_f + Yft V_t)

        y_ser = 1.0 / complex(r, x)
        y_sh = complex(0, b/2)
        
        # Tap on 'from' side? Standard MATPOWER is tap at 'from' bus.
        # Ratio a = tap * exp(j shift)
        a = tr
        
        # Flow f->t
        # I_ft = (V_f - a V_t) / (a * z) No, complex.
        
        # From matpower manual:
        # Yff = (y + j bc/2) / |a|^2
        # Yft = -y / conj(a)
        # S_f = V_f * conj(Yff * V_f + Yft * V_t)
        
        Yff = (y_ser + y_sh) / (abs(a)**2)
        Yft = -y_ser / a.conjugate()
        
        Sf = V[f] * (Yff * V[f] + Yft * V[t]).conjugate() * baseMVA
        
        # To side
        # Ytf = -y_ser / a
        # Ytt = y_ser + y_sh
        
        Ytf = -y_ser / a
        Ytt = y_ser + y_sh
        
        St = V[t] * (Ytf * V[f] + Ytt * V[t]).conjugate() * baseMVA
        
        rating = br[5] # Rate A
        if rating == 0: rating = 99999.0
        
        loading = max(abs(Sf), abs(St)) / rating * 100.0
        
        branch_loading.append({
            "from_bus": br[0],
            "to_bus": br[1],
            "loading_pct": round(loading, 1),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(abs(Sf), 1),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(abs(St), 1),
            "limit_MVA": rating
        })
        
    # Sort by loading
    branch_loading.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
    report["most_loaded_branches"] = branch_loading[:10]
    
    # Feasibility
    # Mismatch
    mis = make_mismatch(V, [complex(Pg[i]-Pd[i], Qg[i]-Qd[i]) for i in range(len(bus))], Y)
    max_p = max(abs(x.real) for x in mis) * baseMVA

        vmax = bus[i][11]
        viol = max(0, v - vmax, vmin - v)
        max_v_viol = max(max_v_viol, viol)
        
    # Branch overloads
    max_br_viol = 0
    for bl in branch_loading:
        if bl["loading_pct"] > 100:
             ovl = (bl["loading_pct"] - 100) / 100 * bl["limit_MVA"]
             max_br_viol = max(max_br_viol, ovl)
             
    report["feasibility_check"] = {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p, 4),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q, 4),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_viol, 4),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_br_viol, 4)
    }
    
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
        
    print("Report generated.")
